cancer_history_summary:
Age: 71
Sex: Female
Cancer type: Glioblastoma
Histology: Astrocytic
Current extent: Recurrent, locally progressive (left temporal lobe, with new infiltrative progression in right parietal white matter)
Biomarkers: EGFR amplification, PDGFRA amplification (CN 8), CDK4 amplification, NF1 loss-of-function, MTAP homozygous deletion, TERT promoter mutation, MGMT unmethylated, low Tumor Mutational Burden (4 mutations per megabase).
Treatment history:
# 2020-01-12: Diagnosis of Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype, WHO Grade 4.
# 2020-07-14: Maximal surgical debulking of left temporal glioblastoma followed by concurrent temozolomide (75 mg/m2 PO daily) plus external beam radiation (60 Gy/30 fractions).
# 2020-09-27: Transitioned to adjuvant temozolomide (150 mg/m2 PO Days 1-5 Q28d) beginning four weeks post-radiation.
# 2021-07-30: Post-treatment MRI showed partial radiographic response (approx. 35% reduction in enhancing component size and marked diminution of surrounding vasogenic edema).
# 2021-09-17: Surveillance MRI showed a new 1.8 cm gadolinium-enhancing nodule abutting the prior surgical cavity, suggesting local recurrence/progression.
# 2022-03-04: Initiated bevacizumab (10 mg/kg IV every 2 weeks) following recurrence.
# 2022-03-04: Experienced grade 3 proteinuria, leading to temporary discontinuation of bevacizumab, which resolved after several weeks off therapy.
# 2022-05-22: MRI demonstrated partial response (approx. 20% linear shrinkage of the nodule) and stable disease.
# 2025-04-04: Enrolled in a phase-II compassionate-use trial combining a selective PDGFRalpha tyrosine kinase inhibitor with standard metronomic temozolomide (150 mg/m2 days 1-5/28 days).
# 2025-07-12: Disease progression noted on MRI with new non-enhancing T2/FLAIR hyperintensity in the right posterior parietal white matter.
# 2025-08-26: Discontinued the PDGFRalpha inhibitor/temozolomide combination and resumed bevacizumab monotherapy.
# Current: Receiving bevacizumab (10 mg/kg IV every 14 days).
general_exclusion_criteria_evidence: History of essential hypertension, controlled on amlodipine 5 mg daily, currently borderline uncontrolled (average home BP 148/92 mmHg). History of grade 3 proteinuria associated with prior bevacizumab exposure, which resolved after drug holiday. History of grade 2 maculopapular rash resolved secondary to PDGFRalpha inhibitor. History of mild, transient lymphopenia without infectious sequelae.

cancer_history_summary:
Age: 52
Sex: Female
Cancer type: Invasive ductal carcinoma of the right breast
Histology: Infiltrating (ductal) carcinoma, NOS, histologic grade II
Current extent: Metastatic (Stage IV T2 N1 M1) with hepatic metastases. Tumor markers: Serum CA 27-29 38 U/mL (trend favorable).
Biomarkers: PIK3CA p.H1047R (activating hotspot), ESR1 p.D538G (ligand-binding domain mutation), TP53 p.R175H (loss-of-function missense), CDK4 amplification, FGFR1 amplification.
Treatment history:
2020-07-07: Initial diagnosis of Stage IV HR+/HER2- breast cancer with liver metastases. Initiated treatment with letrozole 2.5 mg PO daily and ribociclib 600 mg PO daily (3 weeks on/1 week off).
2021-01-19: Molecular testing confirmed PIK3CA p.H1047R, ESR1 p.D538G, TP53 p.R175H, CDK4 amplification, and FGFR1 amplification.
2022-06-06: Patient was on letrozole 2.5 mg PO daily and ribociclib 600 mg PO daily. Achieved Partial Response (PR) on contrast-enhanced CT of the chest/abdomen/pelvis, showing a ~30% decrease in maximal axial diameter of hepatic lesions.
2022-07-28: Continued treatment with letrozole 2.5 mg PO daily and ribociclib 600 mg PO daily.
2023-09-09: Patient was on letrozole 2.5 mg PO daily and ribociclib 600 mg PO daily. Mild transaminitis (ALT 78 U/L, AST 42 U/L) noted, leading to temporary suspension of ribocicibib pending re-evaluation of liver function tests.
2024-08-04: Patient was on fulvestrant 500 mg intramuscularly every 28 days and everolimus 5 mg PO daily (dose-reduced to 5 mg daily after developing Grade 2 stomatitis and hyperglycemia at month 12 of therapy).
2025-01-11: Imaging showed significant metabolic regression of hepatic metastases (SUV_max decreased from 7.4 to 3.2 in Segment IV lesion) and stable subcentimeter pulmonary nodules.
2025-05-02: Patient was on fulvestrant 500 mg IM every 28 days (monotherapy) with zoledronic acid 4 mg IV q4 weeks.
2025-05-19: Bone scan showed a new focal intense uptake in the L4 vertebral body (1.2 cm) consistent with metastatic involvement.
2026-02-15: MRI showed interval growth of the Segment IV hepatic metastasis to 1.2 cm with new peripheral rim enhancement and diffusion restriction, suggesting progressive disease at that site.
2026-03-11: Patient entered a phase II protocol combining alpelisib 300 mg PO daily with fulvestrant 500 mg IM every 28 days, continuing metformin 1000 mg BID for alpelisib-induced hyperglycemia.
2026-05-14: Patient is on alpelisib 300 mg PO daily and fulvestrant 500 mg IM every 28 days. Disease burden is stable across hepatic, pulmonary, and osseous sites.
general_exclusion_criteria_evidence: History of hypertension controlled on lisinopril. History of hyperlipidemia controlled on atorvastatin. History of mild arthralgias and intermittent vasomotor hot flashes related to aromatase inhibition.

cancer_history_summary:
Age: 68
Sex: Male
Cancer type: Small cell lung carcinoma
Histology: Small cell carcinoma
Current extent: Metastatic (Right lower lobe primary, L3 vertebral body, right iliac crest, left adrenal nodule, new hepatic metastasis in segment VII)
Biomarkers: TP53 p.V157F, RB1 exon 9-20 deletion, MYC amplification, STK11 p.F354L, CREBBP p.R1621H. No actionable EGFR, KRAS, or ALK alterations.
Treatment history:
# 1/2022-02-02-2024-02-20: Commenced first-line therapy: carboplatin AUC 5 + etoposide 100 mg/m² every 21 days. Cycle 1: Developed Grade 3 neutropenia (ANC 300 cells/μL) requiring short-course granulocyte colony-stimulating factor (filgrastim) and temporary chemotherapy hold. Cycle 2: Completed without hematologic delay; experienced persistent Grade 2 nausea/emesis, managed with ondansetron and metoclopramide.
# 2022-03-18: Completed four cycles of carboplatin AUC 5 and etoposide 100 mg/m² (total 4 cycles). Received palliative external beam radiation (single 8-Gy fraction) to L3 for pain relief.
# 2022-08-30: Molecular profiling confirmed TP53 p.V157F, RB1 exon 9-20 deletion, MYC amplification, STK11 p.F354L, and CREBBP p.R1621H.
# 2023-12-11: Completed four cycles of carboplatin AUC 5 and etoposide 100 mg/m² (front-line therapy). Received palliative external beam radiotherapy (single 8-Gy fraction) to L3 for pain control. Received prophylactic cranial irradiation (PCI) 20 Gy in 5 fractions.
# 2024-02-20: Completed four cycles of carboplatin AUC 5 and etoposide 100 mg/m² (front-line therapy). Completed prophylactic cranial irradiation (PCI) 20 Gy in 5 fractions.
# 2024-11-17: Completed four cycles of front-line carboplatin AUC 5 + etoposide 100 mg/m² d1–3 Q21d.
# 2024-11-26: Completed four cycles of second-line amrubicin (35 mg/m² d1–3 q21d).
# 2025-06-27: Completed three cycles of second-line amrubicin (35 mg/m² d1–3 q21d).
# 2025-07-03: Completed five cycles of second-line amrubicin (35 mg/m² d1–3 q21d).
# 2025-07-21: Completed five cycles of second-line amrubicin (35 mg/m² d1–3 q21d).
# 2025-10-07: Completed fifth cycle of second-line amrubicin (35 mg/m² d1–3 q21d).
# 2025-10-07-present: Initiated third-line lurbinectedin (3.2 mg/m² q21d).
general_exclusion_criteria_evidence: History of hypertension controlled on lisinopril 10 mg daily. History of hyperlipidemia controlled on rosuvastatin 20 mg nightly. Former tobacco user (40 pack-years, quit 12 years ago). History of Grade 3 neutropenia after Cycle 1 of first-line therapy (required filgrastim). History of Grade 2 nausea/vomiting after Cycle 2 of first-line therapy. History of Grade 3 thrombocytopenia after Cycle 1 of second-line therapy (required platelet transfusion). History of Grade 2 peripheral neuropathy after Cycle 3 of second-line therapy. History of Grade 3 neutropenia after five cycles of second-line therapy (prompted dose reduction). History of Grade 2 anemia after third-line therapy. History of chronic L3 metastatic pain controlled with acetaminophen/codeine and gabapentin. History of osteoporosis on calcium/vit D supplementation.

cancer_history_summary:
Age: 21
Sex: Male
Cancer type: Osteosarcoma, primary bone (distal right femur)
Histology: Conventional high-grade osteosarcoma (Grade III)
Current extent: Metastatic (Right lower-lobe pulmonary nodule, 1.6 cm, showing slow radiographic progression). Tumor markers (AFP, β-hCG, CEA) are within normal limits.
Biomarkers: TP53 p.Arg175His (Pathogenic), PTEN p.Arg233* (Likely pathogenic loss-of-function), RB1 homozygous loss, MDM2 amplification (6-fold), CDK4 amplification (5-fold), ERBB2 (HER2) amplification (8-fold). KRAS p.Gly12Asp (VUS), NF1 frameshift (VUS), ATRX frameshift (VUS).
Treatment history:
# 2020-01-23-2021-01-19: Neoadjuvant MAP (high-dose methotrexate, doxorubicin, cisplatin) completed.
# 2021-06-01: Definitive surgery (wide resection of distal femur with endoprosthetic reconstruction).
# 2021-07-25-2022-04-13: Adjuvant MAP (six cycles of methotrexate, doxorubicin, cisplatin) completed.
# 2022-04-13-2023-04-17: Salvage ifosfamide/etoposide (two cycles) discontinued due to lack of response.
# 2023-11-15-present: Initiated off-label pembrolizumab (200 mg IV q3 weeks).
# 2021-07-25-2022-04-13-2023-04-17: Consolidative SBRT (30 Gy/5 fx) delivered to the right lung lesion at age 21.

Age: 64
Sex: Male
Cancer type: Gastric/Gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma
Histology: Poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma, signet-ring cell type
Current extent: Metastatic (Primary GEJ adenocarcinoma with hepatic metastases and peritoneal carcinomatosis)
Biomarkers: HER2 amplification (IHC 3+, ISH amplified), KRAS G12D mutant, PIK3CA H1047R mutant, MET amplification, FGFR2 amplification, TP53 p.R175H mutant, CDH1 truncation, ARID1A Loss of Heterozygosity, Microsatellite Stable (MSS), low Tumor Mutational Burden (5 muts/Mb).
Treatment history:
# 2020-08-07: Initial diagnosis of HER2-positive gastric/GEJ adenocarcinoma. No prior treatment.
# 2020-09-17: Diagnosis confirmed. No treatment initiated.
# 2020-09-19: Baseline staging CT showed cT3 N1 M1 (hepatic metastases). No treatment initiated.
# 2020-11-24: Baseline staging CT confirmed cT3 N2 M1 with hepatic metastases. No treatment initiated.
# 2020-11-24 - 2021-03-16: Initiated first-line systemic therapy: Capecitabine 1000 mg/m2 orally BID Days 1-14 plus Trastuzumab loading dose 8 mg/kg IV followed by 6 mg/kg IV q21 days (CAPOX + Trastuzumab).
# 2021-03-16 - 2021-05-01: Completed Cycle 2 of CAPOX + Trastuzumab. Grade 2 peripheral neuropathy developed, managed with duloxetine.
# 2021-05-01 - 2021-10-13: Initiated second-line therapy: FOLFIRI (Camptosar + 5-FU + folinic acid) q2w. Grade 3 neutropenia experienced during the last cycle, resolved with G-CSF support.
# 2021-10-13 - 2022-08-06: Completed 8 cycles of FOLFIRI. Grade 2 peripheral neuropathy persisted.
# 2022-08-06 - 2023-06-07: Restaging CT showed radiographic progression with new peritoneal carcinomatosis (omental cake, visceral/parietal implants). Systemic therapy (FOLFIRI) halted due to radiographic progression.
# 2023-06-07 - 2024-02-26: Completed palliative external-beam radiotherapy (EBRT) to L2 vertebral metastasis. Systemic therapy (FOLFIRI) halted due to radiographic progression.
# 2024-08-26 - Present: Initiated third-line therapy with pembrolizumab 200 mg IV q3 weeks (PD-L1 CPS = 15).
# 2024-10-08 - Present: Continued pembrolizumab 200 mg IV q3 weeks.
# 2025-02-10 - Present: Completed last pembrolizumab infusion six days ago.
# 2025-02-10 - Present: Initiated maintenance therapy with Xeloda 1000 mg/m2 BID Days 1-14 q21d.
# 2025-02-10 - Present: Started spironolactone 100 mg PO daily for ascites management.
# 2025-02-10 - Present: Started epoetin alfa 40,000 units SC weekly for anemia management.
general_exclusion_criteria_evidence:
ECOG 1-2 (ambulatory, limited activity due to fatigue/early satiety). History of Grade 2 peripheral neuropathy secondary to oxaliplatin exposure. History of Grade 3 neutropenia during FOLFIRI treatment. History of Grade 2 fatigue related to radiation. History of Grade 2 hypothyroidism secondary to treatment. History of Grade 3 anemia requiring transfusion. History of symptomatic malignant ascites.

cancer_history_summary:
Age: 70
Sex: Male
Cancer type: Metastatic Castrate-Resistant Prostate Cancer
Histology: Adenocarcinoma
Current extent: Metastatic
Biomarkers: AR amplification, TMPRSS2-ERG fusion, PTEN loss-of-function, CDK12 loss-of-function, TP53 p.R248W missense, RB1 loss, Low Tumor Mutational Burden (4.2 muts/Mb), BRCA2 truncating mutation
Treatment history:
# 2020-07-04: Robotic-assisted radical prostatectomy with extended pelvic lymphadenectomy.
# 2020-10-20: Initiated lifelong luteinizing hormone-releasing hormone-releasing hormone (LHRH) agonist therapy (leuprolide) following high-risk pathologic features (pT3a N1, Gleason 9, positive margins).
# 2021-03-13: Initiated combined androgen blockade with abiraterone acetate 1000 mg PO daily and prednisone 5 mg PO twice daily, continued alongside leuprolide injections.
# 2021-04-28: PSA rose from 0.4 ng/mL to 2.6 ng/mL.
# 2022-11-01: Transitioned to enzalutamide 160 mg PO daily (continuing ADT).
# 2022-11-19: Initiated apalutamide 240 mg PO daily while maintaining leuprolide depot injections.
# 2023-12-09: Molecular testing revealed AR amplification, TMPRSS2-ERG fusion, PTEN loss-of-function, CDK12 loss-of-function, TP53 p.R248W missense, RB1 loss, and low Tumor Mutational Burden.
# 2023-12-16: PSA rose from 3.2 ng/mL to 4.1 ng/mL.
# 2023-12-16-present: Initiated investigational combination therapy: rucaparib 600 mg PO BID with enzalutamide 80 mg PO QD, continued with leuprolide depot injections every 3 months.
# 2025-04-07: Initiated combined targeted therapy with rucaparib 600 mg PO BID and low-dose enzalutamide 80 mg PO QD (restart after washout).
# 2026-04-30: Continued combined targeted therapy with rucaparib 400 mg PO BID and low-dose enzalutamide 80 mg PO daily, continued alongside continuous androgen deprivation therapy (Lupron 22.5 mg IM q3 mo).
# 2025-04-07-present: Grade 3 thrombocytopenia resolved after temporary hold and subsequent dose reduction of rucaparib to 400 mg BID; most recent platelet count >150 x 10^9/L.
# 2026-04-30-present: PSA is 3.0 ng/mL, up from 1.5 ng/mL three months prior.
# 2026-04-30-present: Initiated denosumab 120 mg SC monthly for skeletal related event (SRE) prevention.
# 2026-04-30-present: Plan includes repeat ^64Cu-SAR-bisPSMA PET/CT in 2 weeks, discussion of radium-223 dichloride (Xofigo) for symptomatic bone-only disease, and evaluation for cabazitaxel chemotherapy.

Age: 76
Sex: Female
Cancer type: High-grade serous ovarian carcinoma
Histology: High-grade serous carcinoma
Current extent: Metastatic. Stable hepatic disease with progression noted in the form of an interval increase in the dominant right lobe lesion (from 2.2 cm to 3.5 cm) and the development of a new subcapsular lesion (1.0 cm). New subcentimeter peritoneal nodules (≤ 5 mm) have been identified along the right and left paracolic gutters and in the greater omentum. No new extra-hepatic metastases in the thorax, skeleton, or retroperitoneum.
Biomarkers: BRCA2 truncating mutation (p.Ser1982Argfs*22), TP53 missense mutation (p.Arg248Gln), ATM loss, MYC amplification. HRD score 78.
Treatment history:
2021-02-08: Optimal cytoreductive laparotomy (total abdominal hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, infracolic omentectomy, peritoneal washings).
2022-08-08: Completed six cycles of carboplatin/paclitaxel (carbo/pacli). Grade 2 peripheral sensory neuropathy managed with a single dose reduction of paclitaxel to 150 mg/m2.
2022-11-03: Molecular diagnostic report confirming BRCA2 truncating mutation, TP53 missense mutation, ATM loss, and MYC amplification.
2022-08-08-2023-08-18: Initiated maintenance therapy with the PARP inhibitor niraparib (originally 300 mg PO daily), dose reduced to 200 mg PO daily due to Grade 3 thrombocytopenia, and currently stable on the reduced regimen.
2023-08-08-2024-05-10: Initiated second-line treatment with trabectedin (1.5 mg/m² day 1 q21 days) following progression on niraparib.
2024-05-10-2025-06-28: Completed percutaneous radiofrequency ablation (RFA) of the dominant hepatic metastasis (previously 4.2 cm) and stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT) to a solitary para-aortic lymph node (30 Gy/5 fx).
